test_vectors.execution: Not executed. Build, check, formatter, test, and commit commands were prohibited by the task.
test_vectors.integration: Uses the frozen jmax-dom build, navigate, and scalar APIs and the frozen jmax-path parse API. No root APIs or dependency manifests were changed. Production code uses alloc and core through the frozen runner types and supports no_std with alloc.

cases.vectors: Version 1 with an empty step array; omitted timeout defaults to 30000; all five step variants and all four expectation variants; an active connection at scenario end is valid.

Escaped version and connection keys, surrogate-pair rocket and musical symbol, Unicode roles, escaped newlines and quotes, source mutation and drop, exact retained container whitespace, null, booleans, strings, arrays, objects, -0, 1.0, and 1e+999.

Timeouts 1 and 4294967295; endpoints and error codes 0 and 4294967295. Reject negative and minus-zero integer spellings, fractions, exponents, 4294967296, larger-than-u64 values, wrong JSON types, unsupported versions, and zero timeout.

Missing required fields, unknown fields, incorrect field types, non-object variants, empty or multi-key wrappers, unknown variants, and expectation flags other than literal true produce InvalidScenario with top-level or zero-based step context.

Duplicate decoded keys at root, step, variant, expectation, and nested fragment levels; trailing false starts at EMPTY.len() + 3; malformed JSON inside unknown fields retains the exact DOM ABI error. Reject invalid UTF-8, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, literal controls, leading-zero numbers, plus-prefixed numbers, truncated numbers, comments, single quotes, and trailing commas.

Exactly 16777216 scenario bytes is accepted; one extra byte produces PayloadTooLarge at offset 16777216. Reject nesting beyond depth 128 and strings beyond 1048576 bytes. Exactly 100000 valid direct-model steps is accepted; 100001 steps is rejected for both parsed and direct models.

Reconnect after close, assertion after connection close, 64 reverse-inserted connection names, decoded c versus escaped c identity, duplicate active connections, and call/receive/close before connect or after close.

Every call/receive duplicate-response combination remains invalid after reconnect; forward and absent response references fail. Connection and response namespaces are independent and case sensitive. Reject every empty name position; permit explicit empty roles and transport-defined URI strings.

Accept empty and dollar roots, quoted and escaped keys, empty keys, Unicode keys, and index 4294967295. Reject malformed selectors, wildcard/filter syntax, index overflow, and oversized paths. Keys of 4096 bytes and 256 segments are accepted; one beyond either bound fails. ErrorCode permits only a literally empty path.

Direct Rust params and JsonEquals payloads reject empty, trailing, malformed, duplicate-key, lone-surrogate, invalid-number, and invalid-UTF-8 fragments. Model errors do not echo credential-like connection names, unknown field names, or path values.
